name: 2DMaze Static Check — FAIL Expected
description: A static-only assignment that deliberately requires items that do not exist in the 2DMaze project: a missing scene, a missing GameObject, and a missing script file. Intentionally fails with exit code 1 to demonstrate that the inspector correctly identifies different types of missing requirements — SceneExists, GameObjectExists, and FileExists.

staticRules.name: SecretRoom does not exist in any scene

requirements.name: Nonexistent script file is correctly rejected
